objective: Search beyond the current 5x5 corridor ranking to either find a rover-reviewable local window or prove the bounded site remains blocked.

Lowest-risk route candidate found so far; it is progress evidence, not a safe route.
Existing byte-range extraction pattern for adding adjacent LOLA evidence windows.

acceptance_criteria.description: Publish the search radius, sampled windows, ordering rule, CSV checksum, and generator command.
Return at least one lower-risk route candidate or a measured proof that every sampled window remains blocked.
Refresh MoonBook route, corridor, and MoonClaw proposal payloads so the operator can audit the result as files.

safety_gate: Do not promote a widened route candidate until the 9x9 CSV is pinned, MoonBit generation reads it, and Moonrobo handoffs are regenerated from the updated corridor evidence.
next_action: Run the 9x9 LOLA byte-range extraction, pin the CSV checksum, regenerate MoonBit and MoonBook outputs, then re-evaluate Moonrobo preconditions.
